title: Static-Call Origin Rule Interface First
changes: Added declarative static-call origin rule pattern ADT: class_method, class, fallback.
Advanced existing ControllerStaticCallOriginAuthorityInterface to contract version 2 and exposed ordered rules.
Registered DB::table before the DB facade class rule and generic model-origin fallback.
Removed relational helper imports from controllerStaticCallOriginAuthority.ts.
Mapped DB facade calls without table-origin semantics to not_applicable, then closed that result as unresolved at resource model-origin boundary.
Added regression coverage for DB::select and rule ordering.
